description: Liste des ports du système ERS avec données de position is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centre National de Surveillance des Pêches  - CNSP. The system ERS (Electronic Reporting and Recording System) deployed in Europe allows fishermen to fulfil their reporting obligations from their electronic fishing log. This system includes a list of ports from which fishermen can board or land. Coverage: Centre National de Surveillance des Pêches  - CNSP. The portal shows the English title as "List of ERS system ports with position data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centre National de Surveillance des Pêches  - CNSP. Its keywords include maritime, sig, fishing, circabc, localisation, peche. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
